systems.system: SIGTP - Property Management and Transaction Information System
systems.owner: INGT (National Institute for Land Management) leads; NOSI gives technical and operational support
systems.tiers: Municipal councils, land registry offices, notaries and INGT on the four registered islands: Sal, Boavista, Maio and the rural area of São Vicente
Land registry offices, linked to SIGTP

note: Terms of reference for improvements to the land register platform SIGTP; the registry offices it names are land registry offices, and 'RNI' appears only as a user who would approve a land registration request. Nothing on civil registration.
